description: Joins an event for one person. `status` in the result says what happened: going (they have a spot, and `event.where` now has the address or the link) waiting (the event is full: `waitlistPlace` is their place, 1 is next, and they get the next spot that opens, in order, with nothing to do or confirm) or asked (the host approves who joins: they have no spot and no address or link yet, the host answers, and Tempi emails them the answer). `summary` says it in words: tell the person. Tempi emails them the same, with a calendar file when they are going. Keep `url` (or `id` and `token`): it is the only way to see their spot or to leave. Refusals: 409 already_joined (that email is already going, waiting or asking: their link is in their confirmation email), 409 event_over (it started), 409 event_cancelled, 409 waitlist_full (200 people are waiting, or as many are asking and the host hasn’t answered), 429 daily_limit (the address joined many events today). Ask the person for their real name and email: don’t make one up.

email.description: the guest’s email address: Tempi sends their link, and the news when a spot opens, there

name.description: the guest’s name, as the host reads it (no web addresses, at most 100 characters)

slug.description: an event’s slug ("founders-dinner" in meettempi.com/e/founders-dinner), or its whole link

timezone.description: an IANA time zone such as "America/New_York" (abbreviations like EST and offsets like UTC+8 work too)

name: join_event
title: Join an event as a guest
